'''Devin Ray Robinson''' (born March 7, 1995) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for [[Śląsk Wrocław (basketball)|Śląsk Wrocław]] of the [[Polish Basketball League]] (PLK). He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Florida Gators men's basketball|Florida Gators]].

== High School and College ==
Robinson earned Virginia Prep League Player of the Year honors after averaging 24 points, ten rebounds, three blocked shots and two assists per game for [[Christchurch School]] in 2013–14 en route to a runner-up finish in the VISAA Division II State Championship.

He was recruited by [[Billy Donovan]] and chose the [[Florida Gators men's basketball|University of Florida]] over Connecticut, Indiana, Notre Dame and Oklahoma State. Despite being disappointed as Donovan left the Gators for the [[National Basketball Association|NBA]] prior to his sophomore year,<ref name=":0">{{Cite news|url=http://richmondfreepress.com/news/2017/mar/24/chesterfields-devin-robinson-standout-florida-ncaa/|title=Chesterfield's Devin Robinson is standout on Florida NCAA team|access-date=May 27, 2017}}</ref> Robinson stayed at Florida.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.wruf.com/headlines/2017/03/23/player-feature-devin-robinson/|title=Player Feature: Devin Robinson – ESPN 98.1 FM – 850 AM WRUF|website=www.wruf.com|date=March 23, 2017|language=en-US|access-date=May 27, 2017}}</ref>

"Devin runs like a deer and gets his jump shot off so quickly (…) He’s a very talented guy. He can be a force at both ends of the floor", Florida head coach [[Mike White (basketball)|Michael White]] described his game in March 2017 according to richmondfreepress.com.<ref name=":0" />

Robinson averaged 11.1 points and 6.1 rebounds a game in the 2016–17 campaign and then decided to forgo his senior year to launch his professional career and enter the [[2017 NBA draft]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/article/2017/05/19/florida-devin-robinson-strengthens-defense-help-nba-stock|title=Florida's Devin Robinson digs in on defense to boost NBA Draft stock|last=Dortch|first=Chris|website=NBA.com|language=en|access-date=May 27, 2017}}</ref>

== Professional career ==
=== Washington Wizards (2017–2019)===
He went undrafted in the [[2017 NBA draft]], but joined the [[Washington Wizards]] for the [[2017 NBA Summer League]].<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.csnmidatlantic.com/washington-wizards/2017-18-nba-undrafted-free-agent-list-summer-league-rosters|title=2017-18 NBA Undrafted Free Agent List: Summer League rosters|date=June 23, 2017|work=CSN Mid-Atlantic|access-date=July 1, 2017}}</ref> Based on this performance, Robinson was signed to a [[two-way contract]] by the Wizards on July 14, 2017.<ref>{{cite news|title=Wizards Sign Devin Robinson to Two-Way Contract |url=https://wizardstoday.monumentalsportsnetwork.com/2017/07/14/wizards-sign-devin-robinson-to-two-way-contract|work=monumentalsportsnetwork.com|date=July 14, 2017|access-date=July 14, 2017}}</ref> He became the team's second two-way contract that year, meaning he also splits time between the Wizards and a G League that best suits Washington's area.  On November 2, 2017, Robinson was assigned to the [[Delaware Blue Coats|Delaware 87ers]] of the [[NBA G League]], and later in the season, to the [[Westchester Knicks]].

Playing for the Wizards in the [[2018 NBA Summer League]], Robinson led the team in scoring with over 19 points per game.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/summerleague/2018/stats|title=NBA Summer League Stats {{!}} NBA.com|website=NBA.com|language=en|access-date=July 24, 2018}}</ref>

On April 13, 2019, Robinson was arrested and charged with disorderly [[affray]] for an altercation with [[Jalen Mills]] of the [[Philadelphia Eagles]], outside a DC nightclub. Robinson was taken to the hospital with injuries. Later in the day the Wizards said that they would not be extending Robinson's contract.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.nbcphiladelphia.com/news/local/Jalen-Mills-Arrested-DC-for-Fight-Wizards-Player-Philadelphia-508539031.html?_osource=SocialFlowFB_PHBrand|title = Eagles' Jalen Mills Arrested in D.C. For Fight with Wizards Player| date=April 13, 2019 }}</ref>

Robinson joined the Portland Trail Blazers for the 2019 Las Vegas Summer League.

=== Raptors 905 (2019–2020)===
On July 23, 2019, the Toronto Raptors announced that they had signed Robinson.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.nba.com/raptors/press-release/raptors-sign-robinson-brissett-konate|title=Raptors Sign Robinson, Brissett and Konate|date=July 23, 2019|work=NBA.com press release|access-date=July 23, 2019}}</ref> They released him on October 19, 2019.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/raptors-devin-robinson-cut-loose-by-raptors/|title = Raptors' Devin Robinson: Cut loose by Raptors| date=October 19, 2019 }}</ref> He was then added to the roster of their G League affiliate, [[Raptors 905]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Raptors 905 Announce Opening Night Roster |url=https://raptors905.gleague.nba.com/news/raptors-905-announce-opening-night-roster/ |website=NBA.com |access-date=December 5, 2019 |date=November 6, 2019 |archive-date=November 12, 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191112053313/https://raptors905.gleague.nba.com/news/raptors-905-announce-opening-night-roster/ |url-status=dead }}</ref> Robinson averaged 17.5 points, 7.3 rebounds, 1.9 assists, 1.1 steals, and 1 block per game, shooting 55% from the field.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Schmidt |first1=Dakota |title=Let's Appreciate Some G Leaguers: Edition #2 |url=https://www.ridiculousupside.com/2020/3/19/21186921/lets-appreciate-some-g-leaguers-devin-robinson-hollins-christ-koumadje-stephan-hicks |website=Ridiculous Upside |publisher=[[SB Nation]] |access-date=May 3, 2020 |date=March 19, 2020}}</ref>

===Fort Wayne Mad Ants (2021)===
On December 18, 2020, Robinson signed with the [[Indiana Pacers]]. On December 19, Robinson was waived by the Pacers and was later added to the roster of their G League affiliate, the [[Fort Wayne Mad Ants]].

===Taoyuan Pilots (2021–2022)===
On November 10, 2021, Robinson has signed with [[Taoyuan Pilots]] of the [[P. League+]].<ref>{{cite press release |title=領航猿外援戰力到齊 前鋒羅賓森加盟再添禁區大將 |url=https://pleagueofficial.com/news-detail/184 |publisher=P. LEAGUE+ |accessdate=2021-11-10 |date=2021-11-10 |archive-date=2021-11-10 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211110114052/https://pleagueofficial.com/news-detail/184 |url-status=live }}</ref>

===ratiopharm Ulm (2022)===
On September 20, 2022, Robinson signed with [[ratiopharm Ulm]] of the German [[Basketball Bundesliga]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Verletzungsbedingte Unterstützung für die großen Positionen |url=https://ratiopharmulm.com/news/verletzungsbedingte-unterstuetzung-fuer-die-grossen-positionen-1421/ |publisher=ratiopharm ulm |access-date=3 November 2024 |date=20 September 2022}}</ref> On November 18, he left the team.<ref>{{cite web |title=Devin Robinson nimmt seine Ausstiegsoption wahr |url=https://ratiopharmulm.com/news/devin-robinson-nimmt-seine-ausstiegsoption-wahr-1480/ |publisher=ratiopharm ulm |access-date=3 November 2024 |date=18 November 2022}}</ref>

===Bàsquet Manresa (2022–2024)===
On December 12, 2022, Robinson signed with [[Baxi Manresa]] of the [[Liga ACB]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.basquetmanresa.com/noticies/equips/noticies/2022/versatilitat-atletica-al-baxi-manresa-arriba-devin-robinson/|title=Versatilitat atlètica per al BAXI Manresa: arriba Devin Robinson|last=|first=|date=December 12, 2022|website=|publisher=BAXI Manresa|language=En|access-date=December 13, 2022}}</ref> On June 30, 2023, he re-signed with Baxi Manresa for 2023–24 season.<ref>{{cite web |title=Devin Robinson stays at BAXI Manresa |url=https://www.basquetmanresa.com/en/news/teams/news/2023/devin-robinson-stays-baxi-manresa/ |publisher=BAXI Manresa |access-date=3 November 2024 |date=30 June 2023}}</ref>

===Cedevita Olimpija (2024–2025)===
On July 21, 2024, he signed with [[KK Cedevita Olimpija|Cedevita Olimpija]] of the [[Slovenian Basketball League]] and [[ABA League]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-07-21 |title=Devin Robinson je nova okrepitev na položaju krilnega centra! |url=https://cedevita.olimpija.com/devin-robinson-je-nova-okrepitev-na-polozaju-krilnega-centra/ |access-date=2024-07-21 |website=KK Cedevita Olimpija, Ljubljana |language=sl-SI}}</ref>

On March 6, 2025, he was named the Most Valuable Player of the Eightfinals of the Eurocup. He had 21 points and 12 rebounds to lead his team to win.<ref>{{cite web |title=Devin Robinson scores MVP award in the Eighthfinals of the EuroCup |url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/eurocup/1793905/devin-robinson-eighthfinals-mvp-eurocup/ |website=Eurohoops |access-date=11 March 2025 |language=en |date=6 March 2025}}</ref>

===Basket Zaragoza (2025–2026)===
On August 31, 2025, Robinson signed with [[Basket Zaragoza|Casademont Zaragoza]] of the [[Liga ACB]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=International Signings: Thomas, Mané, Graham, Robinson|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2025/08/international-signings-thomas-mane-graham-robinson.html|access-date=October 29, 2025|website=hoopsrumors.com|language=en}}</ref>

===Śląsk Wrocław (2026–present)===
On August 29, 2026, he signed with [[Śląsk Wrocław (basketball)|Śląsk Wrocław]] of the [[Polish Basketball League]] (PLK).<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://wks-slask.eu/devin-robinson-nowym-zawodnikiem-slaska-wroclaw/|title=Devin Robinson nowym zawodnikiem Śląska Wrocław|date=August 29, 2026|website=wks-slask.eu|publisher=pl|language=En|access-date=September 7, 2026}}</ref>
